correctness.rationale: For random-order greedy MIS on a path P_n and endpoint-four-cycle graph B_n=P_n+{0,3}, first-vertex conditioning gives nf_n=n+2sum_{j=0}^{n-2} f_j and F(z)=(1-e^-2z)/(2(1-z)^2). Conditioning on B_n first vertex gives the stated convolution recurrence; the unique power-series solution yields Delta(z)=[(3-3z+z^2)-(3+3z+z^2)e^-2z]/[2(1-z)]. Coefficients give increments -(-2)^(n-2)(n-3)(n-4)/(2n!), Delta_5=1/15, Delta_6=0, alternating strictly shrinking tail, Delta_n>0 for n>=7, limiting (1-7e^-2)/2 and factorial alternating remainder. Independently computed exact expected output from induced-subgraph first-arrival dynamic programming for n=4..11; deltas were 0,1/15,0,4/105,1/45,26/945,41/1575,823/31185. Recurrence and analytic alternating bound, not bounded calculation, establish all orders.
